subject: sci-dym
title: SCI.DYM.------C.CONT.
description: Diagram in WM-12, embedded in Braxton's argument that world creativity 'does not have a real separation between its creativity and science, or its creativity and religion—or its creativity and its community.' SCI-DYM (scientific dynamics) is *crossed* — the (c) prefix reads "the concept of" — with C-CONT (composite continuance), staking the claim that science cannot be detached from a culture's composite continuity. Two argumentative branches expand the subject: SCI-DYM → POST (postulation) → INDIV-TD (individual tendencies), and SCI-DYM → EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics), which branches into MTH (methodology) → INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) → INTR (interpretation) → TRS (transition), and into SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) → AFI (affinity insight). The argument is structural: in world cultures, science's methodology and its spiritual dynamics both branch from expansion dynamics — interpretation and affinity insight emerge through that expansion, not from empirical isolation. The diagram refuses the western analytical separation Braxton names on the preceding page as 'outside of the basic affinity alignment of western functionalism (i.e., science).'
